title: Majestic Rook
reviewNotes: Three branches, 20 exact positions from the complete seven-piece root. g6 exploits the h7 pin before Rxh7+ ...Rxh7 h6 supplies pawn support. The selected ...Rc7 g7+ ...Kh7 g8=Q+ is winning; ...Rxh6 g7+ ...Kh7 g8=Q# is actual mate. The rook-first Rf6 ...Rd7 g6 ...hxg6 Rxg6 ...Rg7 line draws. Stable diagrams were used rather than dragging frames.
